content.short: Nium moves money in real time to accounts, cards and wallets across more than 190 countries.
content.description: Nium is the payout layer behind banks, payroll providers, marketplaces and travel platforms that need to pay people in countries where they hold no presence. It reaches over 190 markets, more than 100 of them in real time, across 38 currencies, and issues cards as well, at a scale of roughly 38 million cards and virtual tokens in a year. Around 60 billion dollars moves through it annually. More recently it added stablecoin backed card issuing, so a business can fund a card program from a token balance while Nium handles conversion and settlement.
